rci1_using_msad.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium dataset; multi-site data from 17 hospitals (healthy controls selected from 7 study sites).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The structural brain imaging data were acquired from the RESTmeta-MDD Consortium (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), which is a collaborative effort involving twenty-five research groups from 17 hospitals in China." "healthy controls were selected from 7 study sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: REST-meta-MDD open-source database used for normative model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "we compared 369 first-episode MDD patients (mean age = 35 years (sd = 12), 249 females; 283 early onset, 86 mid-to-late onset) from the open-source REST meta-MDD database closely matched for age and gender to 490 never-depressed individuals (mean age = 37 years (sd = 14); 309 females)"

rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The structural brain imaging data were acquired from the RESTmeta-MDD Consortium (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019)"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase healthy controls; percentages calculated from N=490.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase healthy controls; age in years; range not reported.
